description: This file defines an interface and related types for an idempotency store in a backend infrastructure, handling storage, retrieval, and management of responses for idempotent requests via a key-based system.

classes.name: IdempotencyOperationHandle
classes.description: A handle representing an in-flight or completed idempotent operation, providing methods to complete the operation with a response or an exception.

methods.name: TryGetCompletedAsync
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a completed stored response for a given composite key.

methods.name: GetOrBeginAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an existing in-flight or completed operation for a key, or begins a new one.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the store, typically used when a request fails before producing a response.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Completes the operation with a stored response.

methods.name: SetException
methods.description: Completes the operation with an exception.
